generalities.text: Main THE ENCYCLOPEDIA OF PURE MATERIA MEDICA By TIMOTHY F. ALLEN, A.M., M.D. Presented by Médi-T <<<<< COMOCLADIA. SLEEP AND DREAMS. ► Sleepiness. ► Night, was restless until 2 A.M.; no sleep, with heat of the hands and head, full, heavy and somewhat accelerated pulse, and cold feet and legs (first night), [7] . ► Dreams. ► Troubled dreams, during sleep, [3] . ► Talking about one's business in sleep, [3] . FEVER. ► Sensation of increased warmth, almost burning, accompanied with painful weakness, extending from the shoulders down to the hands, there remaining, rendering even writing painful, more in palm and wrist (after ten minutes); pain in right hand grows severe, and extends to the elbows (after one hour); much lessened or disappears on getting up and moving around, [7] . ► High fever (from merely passing by, in the shadow of the tree), [6] . ► Some arterial excitement during the night (ninth day), [7] . ► Often, especially after exercise, a feeling as if boiling or heated fluid were in the veins, or as if they were inflamed, mostly along the inside of the upper and forearms (thirteenth day), [7] . ► The hands and head are unusually hot, at night, with sleeplessness until 3 A.M. (thirteenth day), [7] . CONDITIONS. ► Aggravation. ► ( Morning ), Heaviness of head; at 6 o'clock, soreness of eyeballs; bitter taste; in bed, difficulty of breathing. ► ( About noon ), Itching on scrotum, etc. ► ( Afternoon ), At 3 or 4 o'clock, eye painful; at 4.30 o'clock, sensation in molar teeth; at 6 o'clock, pain in forearm. ► ( Evening ), Soreness in eyeballs; catarrhal symptoms; pains in eye; about 8.30 o'clock, stitches in canthus; at 8.30 o'clock, pains around umbilicus, etc.; at 9.30 o'clock, pain across abdomen; at 9 o'clock, after lying down in bed, pains in hypogastric region; at 7.30 o'clock, soreness below ribs; at 8 o'clock, itching on the abdomen; itching on lower extremities. ► ( Night ), Pain, etc., in intestines; restlessness. ► ( In open air ), Lachrymation. ► ( Bright objects ), Eye symptoms. ► ( Cold water ), Pain in molar tooth. ► ( Inspiration ), Pains in scrobiculus cordis; pain in mammary gland. ► ( Looking at lighted candle ), Pain in eye. ► ( Motion ), Pains in eyeballs. ► ( Moving head ), Eye symptoms. ► ( Reading ), Eye symptoms. ► ( During rest ), Itching of various parts. ► ( Stooping ), Headache. ► ( Warm room ), Itching of nose; itching of various parts. ► ( Warmth of stove ), Headache; pains in eyes. ► ( Warm weather ), Itching of various parts. ► Amelioration. ► ( Open air ), The pains; headache; difficulty of breathing; itching. ► ( Exercising the part ), Pain from elbow to fingers. ► ( Sitting quietly before wood-fire ), Eye symptoms. ► ( Heat of stove ), Pain in teeth. ► ( Deep inspiration ), Pain in mammary gland. ► ( Motion ), All pain; difficulty in breathing. ► ( Change of position ), Gives relief. ► ( Pressure ), Aching in molar tooth. ► ( Walking about ), Pain in mammary gland. SUPPLEMENT: COMOCLADIA. Revision of authorities , by Dr. J. Hyde, Am. Observer, xiii, p. 629. 1 , Dr. J. Hyde, proving, 1854, with a drop of the 5/100th dil.; 2 , Miss J., 4 afterwards 3 drops; 3 , Mr. G. took pellets saturated with the 5/100th; 4 , same;...; 8 , provings by Dr. J. Hyde, Am. Obs., xiii, 593, 10 drops in water at 10.30 A.M. and 12.30 P.M., 20 drops at 4.30 P.M.; 8 a , same, 10 drops at 6.30 A.M. (first day), same at 6.10 A.M. (second day), 25 drops at 6.30 A.M. (third day), 40 drops at 4.10 P.M. (seventh day); 8 b , 3 drops at 5.30 P.M. and 11 P.M. (first day), 3 drops at 7.30 A.M. and 1 P.M., 4 drops at 4.45 P.M. and 9.50 P.M. (second day), 8 drops at 12 M. and 2.20 P.M. (third day); 8 c , same, 10 drops at 3 and 10.55 P.M. (first day), same at 7.4 A.M. and 3.30 P.M. (second day), put 2 ounces of cold water and 10 drops of 1st dec. into Fullgraff's inhaler, and inhaled for twenty minutes, at 11.45 A.M. and 3.30 and 10.30 P.M. (tenth day); inhaled twenty minutes at 2.30, 5, and 10.25 P.M. (fourteenth day); inhaled twenty minutes at 2.30 P.M. took 8 drops at 10.55 P.M. (fifteenth day), 12 drops at 4.35 P.M. (sixteenth day). MIND. ► A cheerful condition of mind during the forenoon (first day), [8a] . HEAD. [190.] ► While inhaling at 10.25 P.M., aching in the os frontis and orbital bones (fourteenth day), [8c] . ► Dull aching in the forehead, and on moving the head a sense of fulness, rigidity, and lameness of the muscles of the neck, in the afternoon (sixteenth day), [8c] . ► Pain above the left eyebrow, at 4.12 P.M. (second day), [8c] . ► 11.30 P.M., while lying on the right side, an aching in the right temple, followed by an aching and sense of fulness in the right side of the face (second day), [8b] . ► Aching in the right temple and right orbital bones, at 6 P.M. (second day), [8c] . ► 2.35 P.M., a sharp pain passing down the right temporal ridge and external angular process. Immediately after a sharp pain at the right supraorbital ridge, close to the supraorbital notch (fourth day), [8c] . ► 4 P.M., aching in the right temporal bone, commencing in the temporal ridge and extending to the occiput; the whole base of the head is very painful on moving the head, also the sterno-mastoideus and trapezius muscles (twelfth day), [80] . EYE. ► The Meibomian glands of the upper lid of the right eye are inflamed (fourteenth and fifteenth days); inflammation subsided (eighteenth day), [2c] . EAR. ► Heat and fulness in the interior of the right ear, at 1 P.M. (third day), [3b] . FACE. ► 5.10 P.M., after slight exercise in the open air, and while in my room, an aching in the left maxillary articulation, leaving a sense of fulness; immediately after an aching in right maxillary articulation, terminating in a sharp pain (nineteenth day), [8c] . [200.] ► 5.22 P.M., after a short walk in the open air, and having entered a warm room, an aching in the right maxillary articulation, involving the whole of the right side of head (nineteenth day), [8c] . ► 9 A.M., an aching in the ramus of the right maxilla (seventeenth day), [8c] . ► 10.30 P.M., aching at the base of the right antrum of Highmore, then at the base of the left antrum (tenth day), [8c] . ► 10 A.M., while at rest in my office, heat and sense of fulness in the face, over the superior maxillary bone (first day), [8a] . ► 10 A.M., while at rest in my office a sensation as of a pimple over the right antrum (first day), [8a] . ► 9.15 A.M., sensation as of a scabby eruption on the median line of the lower lip, close to vermilion border (third day), [8a] . ► 10 A.M., while at rest in my office, a corrosive burning on the left side of the lower lip (second day), [8a] . MOUTH. ► 5.30 P.M., aching in the upper molar teeth and gum of the right side, aggravated by cold air (second day), [8b] . ► 1 P.M., immediately after dinner, an aching in the body of the last molar tooth of the right side of the lower jaw (third day), [8b] . ► At 3 P.M., while sitting in my office reading, an aching in the lower incisors, passing to the right cuspid and bicuspid teeth, continuing five minutes (first day), [8] . [210.] ► 4.30 P.M., aching in the lower incisors, which leaves them very sensitive to pressure from the upper teeth (third day), [8a] . ► 5.30 P.M., while at rest in a warm room, a sore aching of the gum of the right upper molar teeth (nineteenth day), [8c] . ► A short, cutting pain in the gum of the first lower molar tooth of the left side, at 1 P.M. (third day), [8b] . THROAT. ► 3.30 P.M., while at rest, a sense of expansion in the sophagus, as of air ascending slowly from the stomach (third day), [3a] . STOMACH. ► Appetite for dinner less than usual (first day), [8] . ► No appetite for dinner (first day), [8a] . ► An acrid, rancid sensation while walking in the open air, at 3.30 P.M., [8] . ► 11 A.M., an eructation of tasteless air (first day), [8a] . ► 10.15 A.M., while at rest, an eructation of air tasting of the drug (first day), [8a] . ► 4.30 P.M., eructation of tasteless air (third day), [8a] . [220.] ► An eructation of sour, acrid water, at 2.5 P.M. (tenth day), [8c] . ► 10.10 A.M., after a walk in the open air and soon after entering my office, an intense acrid eructation, producing momentary strangulation (twelfth day), [8c] . ► Hiccoughed several times, at 3 P.M., immediately after gaped several times (tenth day), [8c] . ► About 11 P.M., while lying on the left side, an expansive, intense distress in the epigastric region, like unto heartburn, extending through the posterior border of the left scapula, continuing half an hour. Amelioration by lying on the right side (tenth day), [8c] . ► 10 P.M., pain in the epigastrium, as of flatus (sixteenth day), [8c] . ABDOMEN. ► Soon a tense feeling in the abdomen, as if the bowels were full of flatus (second day), [8a] . ► Soon after breakfast, and while walking in the open air, expulsion of odorless flatus per anus (second day), [8a] . ► 3.40 P.M., pain in the right side of the abdomen, running downwards, following the course of the rectus muscle (second day), [8c] . ► 7.15 P.M., an aching in the left side of the floating ribs (fifteenth day), [8c] . ► Wandering pain in the right side of the abdomen, at 10 P.M. (sixteenth day), [8c] . [230.] ► 6.25 A.M., after a walk in the open air, and while sitting in my room, a bubbling in the hypogastric region (second day), [8a] . ► Pains in the hypogastrium from flatus, A.M. (second day), [8a] . ► 4.30 P.M., severe flatulent pains in abdomen; 6 P.M., severe flatulent pain in the abdomen, preceding and during a diarrhic stool, followed by feeling of weakness and perspiration on the face and neck (fifteenth day), [8c] . RESPIRATORY ORGANS. ► 7.15 P.M., after a walk in the open air and on seating myself in a warm room, an itching in the right side of the trachea, producing a dry, hacking cough. Soon after an itching in the left side of the trachea, causing a dry hacking cough (fifteenth day), [8c] . CHEST. ► A soreness in the left lung, such as is felt during the convalescence from pneumonia, at 5.30 P.M., while at rest in my office (first day), [8] . ► 11 P.M., while lying on the left side, an aching at the lower third of the sternum, continuing several minutes (tenth day), [8c] . ► 10.50 A.M., while walking in the open air, a sticking pain from without inwards in the region of the cartilages of the sixth and seventh ribs (twelfth day), [8c] . ► While in bed sore aching in the anterior wall of the chest (fourteenth day), [8c] . ► 3.15 P.M., an intense aching at the posterior aspect of the middle of the sternum (fifteenth day), [8c] . ► During the day aching in the anterior wall of the chest (fifteenth day), [8c] . [240.] ► Drawing in the right anterior wall of the chest, soon after 3.50 P.M. (third day), [8a] . ► 3.25 P.M., a drawing, crampy sensation in the right anterior of the chest and axilla, extending down the arm to the fingers, and terminating in a jerking of the little finger (thirteenth day), [8c] . ► 3.40 P.M., pain in the right anterior well of the chest, near the axilla (second day), [8c] . ► 1.30 P.M., while writing, drawing sensation in the right anterior wall of the chest and right arm, passing down the arm to the elbow (third day), [8c] . ► 5 P.M., aching in the right anterior wall of the chest, extending through to the right scapula (tenth day), [8c] . ► At 2.30 P.M., while inhaling, a drawing crampy sensation at the outer border of the right mammary gland, extending to the axilla and arm (fourteenth day), [8c] . ► Pulsating raw pain near the sternal border of the left mammary gland, seeming to be in the cartilage of the fifth rib, at 5 P.M. (second day), [8c] . BACK. ► 3.50 P.M., pain under the lower part of the left scapula (third day), [8a] . ► 2.35 P.M., broad pain passing from the lower angle of the right scapula to the locality of the serrations of the serratus magnus muscles, then a pulsating pain at the posterior aspect of the coccyx (fourth day), [8c] . ► 9.50 P.M., a sore aching at the right scapula (fifteenth day), [8c] . [250.] ► 9.45 P.M., a crampy aching below the right scapula (fifth day), [8] . ► 3.5 P.M., a pulsating pain in the right sacro-iliac articulation, leaving a lameness, which is felt when walking (third day), [8c] . ► 10 P.M., aching in the dorsal region (sixteenth day), [8c] . ► A pulsating pain in the left sacro-iliac articulation, at 2.18 P.M. (third day), [8c] . ► Aching in the coccyx, while in bed (fourteenth day), [8c] . EXTREMITIES. ► Soon after 10.55 P.M., while lying on the left side, a drawing sensation and aching in the upper part of the right forearm, then a pulsating, deep pain in the right gluteal region, just above the tuber ischii, seeming to be in the periosteum, then a sharp pain just above the crest of the right ilium. After which the pain in the right gluteal region returned, then a sharp pain just above the crest of the ilium, then a drawing and aching in the right foot, then a drawing and aching in the anterior muscles of the right forearm, then a pulsating, deep pain in the right gluteal region, sensitive to pressure, then a drawing and aching in the anterior muscles of the left forearm. A drawing in the outer side of the left foot, extending to the plantar aspect, as if the foot would cramp, then a drawing and aching in the left leg, not relieved by motion. A same awning and sense of drawing in the right forearm, near the elbow, then a return of the pain near the right thigh, at the inner border of the sartorius the muscles (first day), [8c] . ► Soon after, 11.30 P.M., an aching in the right ankle, then aching in the right forearm, then a deep, pulsating pain in the right gluteal region, near the tuber ischii (second day), [8b] . ► 6 P.M. drawing in the muscles of the right upper arm, then drawing in the dorsum of the right foot, then drawing in the plantar region of the right foot, shifting from place to place as rapidly as I can write the symptoms (second day), [8c] . SUPERIOR EXTREMITIES. ► While in bed, aching in the muscles of the right arm (fourteenth day), [8c] . ► 3.8 P.M., while at rest, a sharp pain passing through the right shoulder to the scapula (third day), [8a] . [260.] ► 4.15 P.M., while at rest, a drawing sensation and aching, commencing suddenly in the right axilla, moving down the inner side of the arm to the elbow (third day), [8a] . ► 2.30 P.M., while at rest, a lame, aching pain in right upper arm (third day), [8a] . ► 3.45 P.M., drawing, crampy sensation in the muscles of the right upper arm. After a short interval a similar sensation in the right elbow (thirteenth day), [8c] . ► 7.15 P.M., a drawing sensation in the right upper arm, followed by an aching in the left side at the floating ribs (fifteenth day), [8c] . ► 7 P.M., while riding on horseback, a drawing sensation in the muscles of the right upper arm (nineteenth day), [8c] . ► 4.30 P.M., a severe aching pain at the internal condyle of the right arm, after a walk in the open air and while standing in the open air, continuing five minutes; at the same time, and while the arm is resting on a support, a sense of drawing at the inner side of the left upper arm (nineteenth day), [8c] . ► 2.45 P.M., a sharp sticking pain in the right elbow (fifth day), [8c] . ► 3.40 P.M., while inhaling, aching in the right forearm, commencing in the belly of the flexor carpi radialis muscles, extending through the arm. The arm is sensitive to pressure (tenth day), [8c] . ► 9.30 P.M. aching in the left forearm (twelfth day), [8c] . ► 3.45 P.M., sense of drawing in the right forearm, extending to the metacarpus (tenth day), [8c] . [270.] ► 4.30 P.M., a pulsating pain in the interosseous tissue, at the palmar aspect of the left forearm, near the wrist, extending to the little finger, where it becomes a drawing, crampy pain, then a drawing sensation, extending up the forearm from the wrist (third day), [8b] . ► 9.45 P.M., a crampy aching in the right wrist (fifteenth day), [8c] . ► A transient drawing pain passing through the right carpus, leaving the wrist lame on motion, at 10 A.M. (fourth day), [8c] . ► 9.25 P.M., after a walk in the open air and while in my room reading, a sharp pain suddenly pierces the palmar aspect of the left carpus, traversing the dorsum of the first and second fingers, becoming a drawing pain in its progress to the metacarpo-phalangeal articulation of those fingers, then involving all the metacarpo-phalangeal articulations of the hand, drawing the fingers closer together and the thumb towards the palm of the hand. The whole hand is numb, looks and feels swollen, its temperature is increased. Continued motion relieves the drawing, but not the numbness, which continued fifteen minutes (fourth day), [8c] . ► 5.57 P.M., a drawing, crampy sensation in the left carpus, then in the anterior of the right upper arm (twenty-first day), [8c] . ► 3.47 P.M., crampy sensation, increasing to an aching, in the first phalanges of the right hand; continuing ten minutes, relieved by motion of the fingers (tenth day), [8c] . ► 1.30 P.M., while writing, a dancing pain suddenly attacks the right metacarpus, terminating in a lame aching and a drawing sensation in the right metacarpus, terminating in a lame aching and a drawing sensation in the metacarpal region of the thumb and index finger (third day), [8c] . ► 3.30 P.M., a drawing pain in the dorsal aspect of the metacarpal region of the right thumb (fifth day), [8c] . ► 9.32 P.M., during the numbness of the left hand, a sharp pain in the dorsum of the first phalanx of the index finger of the right hand, shooting to the articulation of the first and second phalanx of the index finger (fourth day), [8c] . ► 4.15 P.M., stinging in a small spot on the dorsum of the first phalanx of the second finger of the right hand (tenth day), [8c] . INFERIOR EXTREMITIES. [280.] ► 3.20 P.M., an intermittent, pressing-outward pain at the left sacro-iliac articulation, sensitive to pressure, relieved by walking, but feels lame and sore (third day), [8a] . ► 5 P.M., a pulsating pain in the right gluteal region, near the tuberosity of the ischium, sensitive to pressure (third day), [8b] . ► 3.40 P.M., a pulsating pain at the left pubic bone, continuing several hours, generally relieved by walking, sometimes felt when walking; the pain seems to be in the periosteum; there is sensitiveness on pressure (second day), [8c] . ► 10 A.M., while standing quietly before a hot stove, a return of the pain near the right tuber ischii (second day), [8c] . ► 4.50 P.M., a pulsating, deep pain in the posterior and upper part of the right thigh (third day), [8b] . ► 2.35 P.M., while writing, pain in the upper and posterior part of the left thigh (fifth day), [8c] . ► 4.10 P.M., pulsating pain in the neck on the right femur, seeming to be in the capsular ligament, ceasing while walking, returning when at rest (tenth day), [8c] . ► At night, while in bed, a pulsating pain in the neck of the right femur; this pain was felt several times during the day (eleventh day), [8c] . ► 1 P.M., a pulsating, deep pain in the neck of the right femur; this pain seems to be in the capsular ligament, at the inner border of the ilio-femoral ligament, and continues ten hours, relieved by walking (twelfth day), [8c] . ► 5.5 P.M., a return of the pain in the neck of the right femur, continuing several hours (fourteenth day), [8c] . [290.] ► 3.27 P.M., while at rest, pain along the outer side of the right thigh (third day), [8a] . ► 9.50 P.M., a lame aching at the inner side of the right thigh, just above the knee, followed by a wiry or threadlike pain in the right instep (fifteenth day), [8c] . ► Aching and sense of drawing in the outer hamstring of the right leg, at 3.40 P.M.; return of the aching and drawing, at 4.26 P.M. (second day), [8c] . ► 3 P.M., a lame, aching pain in the right knee (third day), [8a] . ► 9.20 P.M., while seated in a warm room, and immediately after supper, an intense crampy aching in the left knee, continuing eight minutes; not relieved by motion (nineteenth day), [8c] . ► 3.50 P.M., a drawing pain in the right knee, extending into the anterior muscles of the thigh (third day), [8a] . ► 12.30 A.M., while in bed, an intermittent pressing outward pain in the right knee, relieved by motion (second day), [8b] . ► 12 M., aching in the right leg (second day), [8c] . ► 2.50 P.M., a numb aching passing down the outer side of the right leg to the foot, then an aching and sense of drawing in the outer hamstring (third day), [8c] . ► 9 P.M., an intermittent aching in the right tibia (eighteenth day), [8c] . [300.] ► 3 P.M., a pulsating pain in the head of the right tibia, relieved by motion (second day), [8b] . ► 5.30 P.M., while at rest, a pulsating pain in the head of the right tibia; the tibia is sensitive to pressure (second day), [8b] . ► 6.30 P.M., a pulsating pain near the upper extremity and outer side of the right fibula. Immediately after a pulsating pain in the right thigh (third day), [8b] . ► 3.30 P.M., while at rest in my office, the right leg elevated and resting on the table, and after a walk in the open a air, a crampy lameness in the right leg just above the instep, relieved by walking. Immediately after and while at rest, a drawing, crampy sensation in the hollow of the right foot, passing up to the outer ankle and along the outer border of the gastrocnemius muscle to the knee, relieved by walking, returning while sitting, the feet resting on the floor, passing slowly upwards from the outer ankle to the knee, then in the tibia, where it becomes a numb aching, then in the tarsus, where it occasions a drawing aching, as if the foot would cramp; continued motion relieves (second day), [8a] . ► While at rest, a numb, drawing sensation in the left instep, which extended to the knee, followed by a sense as of warm air, like an aura, ascending half way to the knee. The numbness and drawing then concentrated at the instep, where it remained a short time, and again the aura ascended slowly to the knee; at the same time both the tibia and fibula ache; there is also a sense of increases temperature and fulness in the leg. The numb drawing then moved over the dorsum of the foot to the toes, where it terminated in a prickling; relieved by motion, but returned when motion ceased (seventh day), [8a] . ► 4.30 P.M., while at rest in a warm room, a transient pain passing upwards over the inner ankle of the left foot (fifteenth day), [8c] . ► 8.30 A.M., while walking in the open air, sudden lameness and loss of strength in the left ankle (second day), [8a] . ► 12.30 A.M., a crampy aching in the right instep, relieved by motion (second day), [8a] . ► 5.44 P.M., while at rest in a warm room, the atmosphere loaded with moisture, south wind, a drawing, crampy sensation at the dorsum of the right foot, in the region of the external cuneiform bone, spreading outward and over the caboid bone, and forward over the metatarsal bone of the little toe; then moving upwards to the region of the anterior ligament, where the drawing, crampy sensation ceases and becomes a bruised aching, extending to he external malleolus. Sometimes it extends up the tibia and fibula, producing a feeling of fulness in these bones. When walking there is lameness (twenty-first day); 3 P.M., while at rest in the house, a return of the aching in the right foot below the outer ankle, terminating in aching (twelfth day), [8c] . [310.] ► Drawing sensation in the right big toe, as if the toe would cramp, at 6 P.M. (second day), [8c] . ► A sticking pain in the metatarsal joint of the big toe, at the plantar aspect (fourteenth day), [8c] . GENERALITIES. ► Several times during the afternoon a sense of weakness, with heat and perspiration on the face and neck (sixteenth day), [8c] . ► During the forenoon, aching in both sides and upper arms, the right side worse (sixteenth day), [8c] . SKIN. ► 10 A.M., while at rest in my office, itching on the inner side of the left thigh, then above the right eye, then on the scalp; 10.15 A.M., itching at the inner border of the gastrocnemius muscles of the left leg, relieved by rubbing. Immediately after a tingling itching on the right side of the upper lip, then a crawling itching on the right malar region, then an itching moving downwards from the right commissure of the mouth, then an itching on the palmar aspect of the right carpus, moving towards the palm of the hand, then an itching at the angle of the jaw on the right side; 10.55 A.M., itching at the right eyebrow; 11.40 A.M., a biting-corrosive itching on the right forearm, over the belly of the palmaris longus muscle. Immediately after itching on the right side of the face, near the angle of jaw, then itching on the posterior aspect of the right forearm, then an itching on the dorsal aspect of the first phalanx of the index finger of the right hand (first day). During the afternoon itching on different parts of the exterior body (third day), [8a] . ► Itching on the extremities and face (first day), [8] . ► Stinging itching on the right scapula, at 2.45 P.M. (tenth day), [8c] . SLEEP. ► Last night the sleep was dreamy and refreshing. It seemed more like a clairvoyant state. After midnight I dreamed of birds singing, which a woke me, and caused me to listen with intense interest, but stillness and darkness reigned supreme (third day), [8b] . ► The sleep last night was light and dreamy. After midnight I dreamed I entered a beautiful garden, from which I passed into a low woodland, in the eastern border of which was a sluggish, broad, shallow stream of water; to cross dry shod required some exercise of mind. This morning arose from bed refreshed, light-hearted, and cheery (second day), [8c] . Copyright © Médi-T ® 2000 Main

Spasmodic dry cough at night, with tickling in throat, and constant dull pains under l. nipple, extending through to l. scapula. Cannot draw a long breath on account of sharp pain at centre of thorax on l. side. Soreness in l. lung. Sharp pain in l. breast, about one inch above nipple, and leaves a burning sensation; it goes to r. side and down r. arm. Sloughing ulcer on r. breast. Sharp pains through r. shoulder to scapula. Painful burning on arms. Crampy sensation in muscles of r. upper arm. Numb, tensive pain in forearm and rheumatic stiffness of shoulders and elbow-joints. Drawing aching in forearm. Drawing, cramping in fingers. Vesicular eruption on arms and hands. Intermittent, pressing-outward pain in l. sacro-iliac synchondrosis, sensitive to pressure, > by walking, but feels lame and sore. Pulsating pain in neck of r. femur and in r. thigh. Severe pains in both knees; pressing down to feet on inside of legs. Drawing in r. knee extending into anterior muscles of thigh. Drawing, cramping in hollow of r. foot, passing along outer border of gastrocnemius to knee, then in tibia, where it becomes a numb aching, then in tarsus as if foot would cramp. Inflammation of leg and foot with violent fever; swelling increased enormously when pain subsided; skin became white and covered with thin scales, which cracked and discharged a sanious fluid. Vesicular eruption changing to pustules and ulcers. Herpes on legs.

keynotes.text: Main Hand Book of Materia Medica and Homopathic Therapeutics. By T. F. Allen. Presented by Médi-T . Comocladia. A tincture is made of the fresh bark of Comocladia dentata, Jacq. General Action :- ► Almost exactly similar to Rhus tox., Anacardium , Ailanthus and other botanical allies . Generalities :- ► Swelling of whole body ; then redness all over like scarlet fever ( Rhus t .), afterwards color of skin like a mulatto's. Aching in both sides and upper arms, in forenoon, agg. right side. ► General malaise, fever and headache. ► Weakness in afternoon, with heat and perspiration on face and neck. Symptoms agg. left side. ► Symptoms disappear when moving in open air ( Rhus t .). Mind :- ► Cheerfulness in morning ; in forenoon. ► Combative, vindictive disposition, with contempt for opponents. ► (Self-complacent thoughts and contempt for other ?). Head :- ► Aching, stupefying, throbbing ; indescribable A. ► Confusion. ► Heaviness in morning ; H., with enlarged feeling. ► Catarrhal symptoms, with soreness of eyes from 4 or 5 P.M . through the evening, and lachrymation. ► Symptoms worse near stove and when stooping, amel. open air. ► Aching in os frontis and in orbital bones ; deep in brain over right eye ; deep in anterior part of brain on sitting, down ; above left eyebrow at 4.12 P.M . ; in forehead in afternoon, and on moving head sense of fulness, rigidity and lameness of muscles of neck. ► Heaviness in forehead and eyes. Temples :- ► Pain ; in right ; in right at 1 P.M . ; in right at 6 P.M ., and in right orbital bones ; in right at 11.30 P.M . while lying on right side, then pain and sense of fulness in right side of face ; in right bone, beginning in temporal ridge at 4 P.M . and extending to occiput, with pain in whole base of brain on moving head and in mastoideus and trapezius muscles ; sharp at 2.35 P.M . passing down right temporal ridge and external angular process, then sharp pain in right supraorbital ridge, close to supraorbital notch. ► Intermittent pain in right side. ► Constriction in sides. ► Sharp pain in occiput, extending down neck. ► Itching of scalp ; mostly in superior left parietal region. Eyes :- ► Look dull and glassy, vessels congested, lids red, swollen and inflamed. ► Pain in right at 3 or 4 P.M ., with feeling as if larger and more protruded than left ; P., agg. near a stove , with lachrymation when stooping, and with soreness of eyeballs, agg. right ; from posterior part of right through head to occipital protuberance, with soreness of eyeball, lachrymation and feeling as if the eye were as large as two eyes, next morning sore feeling in eye. ► Feeling heavy, larger, painful, pressing out of head, as from a pressure on top of eyeballs moving them downward and outward ( Rhus t. ). ► Symptoms agg. left towards and during evening ; S. agg. right during the day ; agg. moving head reading, looking at a lighted candle and bright objects. ► Symptoms amel. sitting quietly before a wood fire on the hearth. ► Lachrymation from looking at a lighted candle, with increase of pain in eyes ; L. agg. in open air. Balls :- ► Intermittent pain from posterior part of both through head to below occipital protuberance, with pressure on superior surface of balls, seeming to move eyes downward and outward. ► Soreness in evening ; of right at 6 A.M ., agg. moving eye ; aching, from 4 or 5 P.M . till 10, agg. evening, by candle-light and by motion, caused flow of tears. ► Feeling worse on moving them . Lids :- ► Inflammation of Meibomian glands of right upper. ► Stitches upward in left external canthus about 8.30 P.M . ► Itching at right external canthus, then at lower border of left eye. Clinical :- ► Ciliary neuralgia from asthenopia and pain from other causes, especially if the eye feels large and protruding. Ears :- ► Pain extending to lower jaw. ► Heat internally in right at 1 P.M ., with fulness. ► Ringing, with vertigo. Nose :- ► Itching internally and externally over all that part inferior to bridge, until going to sleep at night, momentarily amel. by rubbing. Face :- ► ► Swollen, with eyes projecting from their sockets and ability to see only a faint glimmer of light with the left ( Rhus t .) ; S. around eyes at 6 A.M ., much puffed below superior tarsal cartilage in afternoon. ► Aching at base of right antrum of highmore at 10.30 P.M ., then at base of left. ► Sensation as if skin were drawn up from face and about nose, causing vertigo. Jaw :- ► Aching in ramus of right at 9 A.M . ; in left articulation at 5.10 P.M . after light exercise in open air, leaving in sense of fulness, then aching in right articulation ending in sharp pain ; in right articulation, involving whole right side of head, at 5.22 P.M . on entering a warm room after a walk in open air. Lips :- ► Dry and chapped ; and often bleeding. ► Sensation as of a scabby eruption on median line of lower, close to vermilion border. ► Corrosive burning on left side of lower at 10 A.M . while at rest. Mouth :- ► Molar :- ► Aching in body of last right lower, at 1 P.M ., after dinner ; in right upper, at 5.30 P.M ., agg. cold air, and in gum ; sore pulsating in body of right upper middle, at 6.30 P.M ., amel. holding right side of face to the stove ; in a right upper middle (the molar below it is carious), agg. at 12 M. and becoming twitching, that is, a sensation as if the tooth were drawn out of the socket, putting the nerve on the stretch, and suddenly pressed into the socket again, the pain shooting into temple, lasting till 3 P.M ., agg. holding cold water in mouth, amel. pressure of hand and holding affected side close to hot stove, with elongated sensation. ► Loose sensation in right at 4.30 P.M . ► Aching in lower incisors at 3 P.M . while reading, passing to right cuspid and bicuspid teeth ; A. in lower incisors at 4.30 P.M ., leaving them sensitive to pressure of upper teeth. ► Intermittent aching in bodies of all teeth. ► Swelling of the gum of a carious tooth. ► Cutting in gum of first left lower molar at 1 P.M . ► Aching in gum and root of right middle lower molar (which is hollow and loose) till going to sleep at 9.30 P.M ., amel. holding right side of face to the fire ; sore, in gum of right upper molars at 5.30 P.M ., while at rest in a warm room. Tongue :- ► Dryness at night, and of mouth ; like a chip, with burning and swelling of lower lip, which remains chapped. ► Burning ; in forenoon, with redness and dryness, especially of anterior part. ► Burnt feeling ; and smoother and redder at tip than usual. Throat :- ► Attacks of inflammation. ► Hawking up of mucus. ► Roughness, with scraping. ► Difficulty in empty deglutition. ► Sense of expansion in sophagus at 3.30 P.M . while at rest, as of air slowly ascending from stomach. Stomach :- ► Appetite for dinner less than usual ; no A. for dinner. ► Eructations ; with relief ; frequent at 9 A.M . ; of air at 11 A.M . ; of air at 4.30 P.M . ; of air tasting of the drug at 10.15 A.M ., while at rest ; of sour acrid water at 2.5 P.M . ; acrid producing momentary strangulation, at 10.10 A.M ., after walking in open air. ► Hiccough at 3 P.M ., then gaping. ► Nausea. ► Stitches in every direction in pit while lying on left side at night, inspiration. ► Pain in epigastrium at 10 P.M ., as from flatus. ► Expansive distress in epigastric region, like heartburn, extending through posterior border of left scapula, about 11 P.M ., while lying on left side, amel. lying on right side. ► Acrid, rancid sensation at 3.30 P.M ., while walking in open air. Abdomen :- ► Flatulence, with noisy eructations and discharge of flatus. ► Discharge of flatus, with desire for stool ; of odorless flatus while walking in open air after breakfast. ► Full feeling, with pain. ► Pain in evening ; P. agg. eating ; with distention, rumbling and discharge of flatus ; in various parts, sometimes mounting to axilla ; in attacks, agg. right side, and agg. sitting in-doors. ► Tensive feeling, as from flatus. ► Uneasiness ; with pain. ► Stinging in hypochondrium at 11 A.M . ► Aching in left side at floating ribs at 7.15 A.M . ; in left side and rumbling of flatus, extending over abdomen ; in right side, extending down course of rectus muscles, at 3.40 P.M . ; wandering in right side at 10 P.M . ► Pains around umbilicus at 8.30 P.M ., extending to epigastrium. ► Sore pain extending across umbilicus at 9.30 P.M ., affecting with emission of hot flatus. ► Pain in right ilio-ccal region, coming on like a thrust. Hypogastrium :- ► Bubbling at 6.25 A.M ., while sitting after a walk in open air. ► Pain at night, with gurgling, uneasiness and emission of odorless flatus. ► Flatulent pain ; at 4.30 P.M ., with emission of flatus, then pain in abdomen, at 6 P.M . flatulent pain in abdomen, preceding and during diarrha, then weakness and perspiration on face and neck. ► Shifting pains at 9 P.M . in bed. ► Throbbing in left posterior side of abdomen, between spleen and kidneys, from twitching of tendons. Stool and Urine :- ► Stool loose ; and urgent, with aching at anus. ► Stool omitted. ► Urine covered with a pellicle and containing a cloud of mucus suspended in it, next day urine scanty. Scrotum :- ► Numb tensive pain at 10 P.M ., extending to inner condyle of thigh. ► Itching ; when sitting and standing ; about noon, and on lower part of penis, extending ; about noon, and on lower part of penis, extending to prostate gland, and on inner surface of prepuce ; tingling left at night. Respiratory Organs :- ► Itching in right side of trachea at 7.15 P.M ., after walking in open air, producing a dry, hacking cough, then itching in left side of trachea, causing dry, aching cough, then itching in left side of trachea, causing dry, hacking cough. ► Cough at night in bed, from irritation. Chest :- ► Stitches just below apex of heart ; beneath sternum, agg. towards right side ; inward in cartilages of sixth and seventh ribs, at 10.50 A.M ., while walking in open air. ► Prickling in costal cartilages of eighth, ninth and tenth right ribs. ► Aching in anterior wall during the day ; in right anterior wall, near axilla, at 3.40 P.M . ; in right anterior wall at 5 P.M ., extending through to scapula ; at posterior aspect of middle of sternum at 3.15 P.M . ; in lower third of sternum at 11 P.M ., while lying on left side in left mamma, above nipple, at 3.30 P.M ., while sitting in-doors sometimes like a throbbing sore pain, sometimes as from pressure of the edge of a knife, amel. walking and deep inspiration, agg. expiration, with bruised feeling in ribs beneath when pressed by the hand, a return of the pain at 5 P.M ., after supper, after leaving the mamma it passes down the side as low as the spleen, at 6.30 a return of the pain in the mamma, after leaving mamma lancinating pain passing down right side of chest and inner side of right upper arm, then to elbow, down forearm and along dorsal surfaces of second and third fingers, then pain in left carpus, the pain returning at 7.25 and 9.20. ► Sharp pain in upper part, apparently in pleura, at night in bed, on deep inspiration. ► Pulsating raw pain near sternal border of left mamma, seemingly in cartilage of fifth rib, at 5 P.M . ► Sore aching in anterior wall while in bed. ► Sore spot below left ribs at 7.30 P.M ., then worse below right ribs. ► Soreness in left lung, as during convalescence from pneumonia, at 5.30 P.M . while at rest. ► Drawing in right anterior wall soon after 3.50 P.M . ; at 1.30 P.M . while writing, and in right arm, passing down arm to elbow. ► Drawing crampy sensation at outer border of right mamma, extending to axilla and arm, at 2.30 P.M ., in right anterior wall of chest and axilla at 3.25 P.M ., extending to fingers and ending in jerking of little finger. ► Feeling of fulness and tightness across lower part of chest and upper part of abdomen, as if nothing could move, with swelling and with difficulty of breathing, the last, agg. morning in bed, amel. moving about and in open air. Heart and Pulse :- ► Palpitation in morning on slight exercise. ► Pulse accelerated every day at 9 A.M . ► Arterial excitement at night. Back :- ► Scapula. ► Pain under lower part of left at 3.50 P.M . ; crampy below right at 9.45 P.M . ; sore at right at 9.50 P.M . ; sharp broad, from lower angle of right to locality of serrations of serratus magnus muscles, at 2.35 P.M ., then pulsating pain at posterior aspect of coccyx. ► Aching in dorsal region at 10 P.M . ; in coccyx while in bed. ► Pulsating pain in periosteum of left pubic bone at 3.40 P.M ., generally amel. walking, sometimes felt when walking, with sensitiveness to pressure. ► Pulsating pain in left sacro-iliac articulation at 2.18 P.M . ; in right at 3.05 P.M ., leaving a lameness, which is felt when walking. ► Intermittent pressing-outward pain at left sacro-iliac articulation at 3.20 P.M ., amel. walking, with sensitiveness to pressure, then lameness and soreness. Extremities :- ► Aching in right ankle at 11.30 P.M ., then in right forearm, then deep pulsating pain in right gluteal region near tuber ischii. ► Drawing in muscles of right upper arm at 6 P.M ., in dorsum of right foot then in plantar region of right foot, shifting rapidly from place to place. ► Drawing in upper part of right forearm at 11 P.M ., while lying on left side, with aching, then pulsating deep pain in right gluteal region, then sharp pain above crest of left ilium, then drawing and aching in right foot, then in anterior muscles of right forearm, then pulsating deep pain in right gluteal region, sensitiveness to pressure, then drawing and aching in anterior muscles of left forearm, drawing in outer side of left foot, extending to plantar aspect, as if the foot would cramp, then drawing and aching in left leg lame aching and drawing in right forearm, near elbow, then return of the pain near right tuber ischii, then aching in right leg, then pulsating deep pain in right thigh at inner border of sartorius muscle. Upper Extremities :- ► Axilla :- ► Drawing or cramplike pain in right. ► Heavy drawing pain in left, extending towards shoulder, with sensation as if shoulder would be drawn towards neck. ► Sudden drawing at 4.15 P.M ., while at rest, moving down inner side of arm to elbow, with aching. ► Sharp pain through right shoulder to scapula, at 3.08 P.M . while at rest. ► Trembling of left arm and left shoulder when reclining and supporting body with left hand. ► Aching in muscles of right arm while in bed. ► Right arm more painful, but in left more tremulous sensation (and loss of power ?). ► Pain at internal condyle of right arm at 4.30 P.M ., while standing in open air, at the same time and while arm is resting on a support drawing at inner side of left upper arm. Upper Arm :- ► Pain extending from a little above elbow down posterior part of arm, dorsum of hand, to ends of fingers, amel. exercising arm, with numbness of arm while holding anything with hand. ► Lame pain in right at 2.30 P.M ., while at rest. ► Drawing in right at 7.15 P.M . ; in muscles of right at 7 P.M . while riding on horseback. ► Drawing crampy sensation in muscles of right at 3.45 P.M ., then in right elbow. ► Sticking in right elbow at 2.45 P.M . ► Aching in left forearm at 9.30 P.M . ; in right at 3.40 P.M ., beginning in belly of flexor carpi radialis, extending through arm, with sensitiveness of arm to pressure. ► Pulsating pain in interosseous tissue of palmar aspect of left forearm, near wrist, at 4.30 P.M ., extending to little finger, where it becomes a drawing, crampy pain, then a drawing sensation, extending up forearm from wrist. ► Numb tensive pain in forearm at 6 P.M ., with rheumatic stiffness of shoulders and elbows. ► Drawing in right forearm at 3.45 P.M ., extending to metacarpus. ► Numbness of forearm, especially along ulnar nerve to end of last two fingers, and prickling when resting on elbow. Hand :- ► Trembling of left and of forearm. ► Sudden dancing pain in right metacarpus at 1.30 P.M . while writing, ending in lame aching and drawing in metacarpal region of thumb and index. ► Drawing pain in dorsal aspect of metacarpal region of right thumb at 3.30 P.M . ► Drawing crampy pain middle of right palm, extending to tips of fingers (not thumb), as if fingers would be drawn towards palm. ► Painful weakness of right, especially the two last fingers are inclined to numbness when writing. ► Numbness of left at 9.30 P.M ., with pain in dorsum of first phalanx of right index shooting to joint of first and second phalanges of index. Finger :- ► Stinging on dorsum of first phalanx of right second, at 4.15 P.M . ► Pain in palmar surface of last phalanx of third, at 3 and 7 P.M . ; in right little while reading. ► Crampy sensation in first phalanges of right, at 3.47 P.M ., increasing to aching, amel. motion of fingers ; drawing C. sensation in first phalanx of right ring and sensation as if the finger would be flexed on palm, this drawing seemed to move towards metacarpo-phalangeal joint, appearing next day in first phalanx of right ring finger, then in first phalanx of right index. Lower Extremities :- ► Twitching of tendons of right buttock at 8.30 P.M . ► Aching in outer hamstring of right leg in afternoon, with drawing ; A. in upper and posterior past of left thigh at 2.35 P.M . while writing along outer side of right thigh at 3.27 P.M ., while at rest ; near right tuber ischii at 10 A.M . while standing before a stove. ► Pulsating pain in neck of right femur ; in capsular ligament at 4.10 P.M ., amel. walking returning during rest ; pulsating P. in gluteal region, near right tuber ischii, at 5 P.M ., with sensitiveness to pressure. ► Pulsating, deep pain in posterior and upper part of thigh at 4.50 P.M . ; at inner border of right ilio-femoral ligament, at 1 P.M ., amel. walking. ► Lame aching at inner side, just above right knee at 9.50 P.M ., then wiry or threadlike pain in right instep. ► (Tensive pain in anterior and lower part of thighs at 8 P.M ., agg. right, with bruised feeling in periosteum on pressure.). Leg :- ► Aching in right at 12 M. ; above right ankle at 9 P.M ., while sitting, amel. walking, returning on sitting down ; intermittent, in right tibia at 9 P.M . ► Pulsating pain in head of right tibia at 3.20 P.M ., amel. motion ; in head of right tibia at 5.30 P.M ., while at rest, with sensitiveness of tibia to pressure ; pulsating near upper and outer side of right fibula at 6.30 P.M ., then in right thigh. ► Numb aching passing down outer side of right to foot at 2.50 P.M ., then aching and drawing in outer hamstring. ► Crampy lameness in right leg, just above instep, at 3.30 P.M ., while the leg is resting on a table, amel. walking, then while at rest drawing crampy sensation in hollow of right foot, passing up outer ankle and along outer border of gastrocnemius muscle to knee, amel. walking, returning while sitting with feet resting on floor, passing slowly from outer ankle to knee, then in tibia, where it becomes a numb aching, then in tarsus, where it causes drawing aching as if foot would cramp, amel. continued motion. Ankle :- ► Pain passing upward over left inner, at 4.30 P.M ., while at rest in a warm room. ► Sudden lameness in left at 8.30 A.M ., while walking in open air, with loss of strength. Foot :- ► Threadlike pain below right outer ankle at 4.30 P.M ., ending in aching. ► Drawing crampy sensation at dorsum of right, in region of external cuneiform bone, at 5.45 P.M . (while at rest in a warm room, the air being moist), spreading outward and over cuboid bone and over metatarsal bone of little toe, then moving to region of anterior ligament, where it becomes a bruised aching, extending to external malleolus, sometimes up tibia and fibula, causing a full feeling in those bones, with lameness when walking, next day at 3 P.M ., while at rest, return of the aching in right ankle. Instep :- ► Pain in right ; crampy, in right at 12.30 A.M ., amel. motion. ► Numb drawing in left, extending to knee while at rest, then sensation as of warm air, like an aura, ascending half way to knee the numbness and drawing then concentrated at instep, and again the aura ascended slowly to knee at same time aching in tibia and fibula, with heat and fulness in leg, then the numb drawing moved over dorsum of foot to toes. ► Where it ended in prickling, amel. motion, returning when motion ceased. Toes :- ► Sticking in metatarsal joint of great, at plantar aspect. ► Drawing in right great at 6 P.M ., as if it would cramp. Skin :- ► Pale redness on lower part of right hypochondrium, down to crest of right ilium, and extending two thirds across abdomen, with papillæ, next morning similar appearance (though less marked) on left side. ► Red and white streaks (the former broader) on back and right half of abdomen, outer part of right thigh and as high as scapula, at 9 P.M ., the redness amel. pressure but returning immediately. ► Burning eruptions occasionally. ► Pimples (some of them white at apex) on back part of neck, shoulders, scapulæ and lower down on back ; red, hard, on left side of sacrum, with pain on touch ; round dull, red, on right scapula, anterior and upper half of left forearm, in same region of right arm, but more numerous on left ; and on outer and upper part of left calf those on left half and left arm looking dry and scaly. ► Inflammation of the part, with deep, hard-edged ulcers, which discharge a thick, fetid, purulent, greenish-yellow matter, the parts becoming in appearance similar to raw, decayed meat, while the surrounding skin is covered with shining scales. ► Itching on various parts ; in afternoon ; in evening ; at right eyebrow ; on face ; on face, most about mouth ; on abdomen ; on scrotum ; on extremities ; on dorsum of left hand on left scapula and inner side of thighs ; in upper part of calves ; on various parts of lower extremities in forepart of day, and in evening ; below right elbow at 7.30 P.M ., amel. rubbing, with sensation as if it would return if I ceased rubbing ; of palm, amel. getting up and moving around, with warmth in it ; on inner side of left thigh at 10 A.M ., then above right eye then on scalp, at 10.15 at inner border of left gastrocnemius, amel. rubbing, then tingling I. on right side of upper lip, then crawling itching on right malar region, then left moving downward from right commissure of mouth, then left on palmar aspect of right carpus, moving towards palm, then on right angle of jaw. ► Stinging itching on right scapula at 2.45 P.M . ; between metacarpal bones of right thumb and index at 3.30 P.M ., and itching on lower part of left scapula, with sensation as if there were pimples there, then on right scapula, with sensation as if there were pimples there, then on right scapula. ► Biting-corrosive itching on right forearm, over belly of palmaris longus muscle at 11.40 A.M ., then itching near right angle of jaw, then on dorsal aspect of first phalanx of right index. ► Burning itching on whole body ; on right ear and surrounding tissue, extending into whiskers. ► Itching of nose, burning in open air, agg. in warm room. ► Burning tingling itching on lower extremities. ► Tingling itching on lower part of sternum, then on whole chest ; on ankle ; along lower part of sternum, then on whole chest ; on ankle ; along lower extremities, changing its position, amel. scratching ; on various parts, mostly extremities, agg. the longer it lasts, amel. rubbing, scratching, in open air and on motion, agg. warmth and rest, in forepart of the day worse on upper extremities in the after part worse on lower extremities, the left first, then on right lower extremity, the itching changing places rapidly, amel. rubbing or scratching, agg. warmth and rest, for the most part proceeding from above downward, especially on lower limbs, and generally of a tingling character. Clinical :- ► In erysipelas of face. Sleep :- ► Night restless till 2 A.M ., no sleep, with heat of hands and head, full heavy and accelerated pulse, cold feet and hands. ► Dreamy and refreshing, seeming more like a clairvoyant state, after midnight dream of birds singing, which woke me and caused me to listen. ► Light, dreamy and refreshing, after midnight dream of entering a beautiful garden, from which I passed into a low woodland, in the eastern border of which was a sluggish, broad, shallow stream of water, and to cross dryshod required some exercise of mind. Fever :- ► Heat ; over superior maxillary bone at 10 A.M ., while at rest with sense of fulness and with sensation as of a pimple over right antrum. ► Burning on face and arms , especially about eyes , warmth with painful weakness , extending from shoulders to hands, and remaining there, more in palm and wrist afterwards pain in right hand grows severe and extends to elbow, amel. getting up and moving around. ► Burning in finger-tips, agg. right, with aching. Comocladia shows its botanical affinity with the Rhus family by the virulence of its effects on the skin, the slightest contact, and, at times, even walking in the neighbourhood of the growing tree, being sufficient to cause violent inflammation. The trunk and branches of the tree contain a milky fluid, turning black on exposure to sunlight, discolouring the skin, linen, &c. (Compare the "Marking Nut" Anacardium.) The plant causes tormenting itching, swelling, redness, vesication, ulceration. Hale quotes from Navarro cures of ulcers: "Sloughing ulcer of right breast." "Indolent ulcer, lower third right leg," deep, discharging sanious fetid pus. "Inflammation of left leg and foot, with enormous swelling and fever." A cough, with pain under left breast going through to left scapula, has several times been cured with Comocl. The eye symptoms are peculiar: pain in right eye, sensation as if it were larger than left, and more protruded. There are also rheumatic pains, and, as with Rhus, these and the symptoms in general are > by motion and by rest. In contradistinction to Rhus, heat and open air > most of the symptoms. Most symptoms are at night as with Rhus. Pressure >.

_raw: Compare: Anac., Rhus, Euphorb. (red stripes on skin); Apis (eye symptoms near stove).

head.text: Giddiness on rising from bed; everything looks dark; > motion; heat. Severe pain at intervals from posterior portion of eyeballs to occipital protuberance; near warm stove; when stooping; > in open air. Corrosive itching with shooting pains, > by movement.

eyes.text: Eyes protrude; feel sore; feel heavy; as if pressed out from above. Eyeballs feel worse on moving them. R. eye painful, feels much larger and more protruded than l. (3 or 4 p.m.). Eyes near warm stove. Sees a red ring round flame of lamp.

ears.text: Heat and fulness in interior of r. ear. L. ear all cracked, and desquamating a substance like powered starch.

face.text: Burning; extreme swelling; heat and itching of face. Aching first in l. and then in r. maxillary joint on entering a warm room. Aching in base of r. antrum of Highmore, afterwards in l., sense of heat and fulness, sensation as of a pimple on r. antrum. Lower lip blistered and swollen. Sensation as if the skin was puckered or drawn up from the face and about the nose, causing slight giddiness.

mouth_throat.text: Sensation as if a tooth were being drawn out of its socket, putting the nerve on the stretch. Pains in teeth > by pressure. When toothache stops, head feels large. Second r. molar carious, pain commences in it 4.30 to 5 p.m.; at times shoots down in line with larynx, leaving sore track; pain in bed, > by external warmth and pressure. Gums of lower jaw inflamed. Tongue coated dirty yellow. Mouth dry.

stomach_abdomen.text: Some eructations two hours after eating. Pressure and heaviness in region of stomach.

stool_rectum.text: Severe flatulent pain in abdomen preceding and during a diarrhœic stool; followed by a feeling of weakness and perspiration on face and neck.

male.text: Intense itching on lower part of penis, also on inner side of prepuce. Continued tingling, itching of scrotum during night. 17.

back.text: On moving head, sense of fulness, rigidity and lameness of muscles of neck. Rheumatic pains and stitches in back; stitches leave a burning.

skin.text: Tormenting itching and burning over whole body. Red all over like scarlet fever. Red stripes on skin. Enormous swelling; vesicles; desquamation; ulcers. Malignant erysipelas; herpes; zona; leprosy.

sleep.text: Dreamy, refreshing sleep with pleasant dreams, almost clairvoyant. Copyright © Médi-T ® 2000 Main.
